LwM2M_COSE.label: LwM2M COSE
LwM2M_COSE.description: This Object provides the keying material and related information for use with COSE.

KID.label: KID
KID.description: This resource is used to indicate the key identifier.

AEAD_Algorithm.label: AEAD Algorithm
AEAD_Algorithm.description: This resource is used to store the encoding of the AEAD Algorithm as defined in Table 10 of RFC 8152.

Key.label: Key
Key.description: This resource is used to store the key for use with the indicated AEAD algorithm.
